item.text:
Implemented Task 001 and committed it as `1fb448a47fba0695b9c8784b8c59a3fed5ee70be`.

Start the app with `npm start`. It binds to `0.0.0.0` on `PORT` (default `8080`) and stores projects in SQLite at `DB_PATH` (default `workboard.sqlite`). The project list, creation, and detail page are implemented in [public/index.html](/home/agent/work/public/index.html) and [server.js](/home/agent/work/server.js).

Verified the health endpoint, trimmed project creation, list and detail routes, and data persistence after restarting the server. `git status --porcelain` is empty.
